notes.title: Upcoming Mr Rabbit DLC in the works!
notes.content:
A new Mr Rabbit DLC is in the works!

Mr Rabbit's Cambridge Point and Click Adventure was initially a short Hidden Object-Point and Click game made with the intention to showcase chinnyinc's work during her exhibition at P320 Community Space. During the final stages of development, I've decided to extend Mr Rabbit's story with yet another work from author and illustrator, chinnyinc.

A River Found in Grisek is one of chinnyinc's books, published back in 2021. It tells the story of a girl who heard the cries of the river deity and embarked on an inquisitive journey to save her town. The characters and story will be adapted into the game with the addition of Mr Rabbit and Audrey in the narrative (with more silly squabbles, of course :P)

The title will be announced at a later date. I will keep the updates coming on Steam and on my twitter.
https://twitter.com/SoyaDaizu
